headline: YC-backed fintech startup launches MCP for secure money transfers
body: Versine, a Y Combinator F26 company, launched a Model Context Protocol (MCP) designed to enable secure sending and receiving of money through AI agents. The move reflects growing infrastructure investments in making financial operations compatible with autonomous AI systems. For healthcare organizations, this matters because payment processing, claims handling, and revenue cycle management increasingly rely on agent-based workflows. The emergence of standardized protocols like MCP for financial transactions suggests vendors will need to integrate secure payment capabilities into EHR systems and healthcare AI platforms. Healthcare AI consultants should monitor how fintech infrastructure standards evolve, as they directly impact how health systems will automate financial workflows at scale.
